        has_batchim = final_index != 0

            if final_index == 8:  # ㄹ batchim

        # Digit
        digit_str = ""

        # Korean pronunciation of numbers (Sino-Korean)
        # Map last digit/number to how it's pronounced
        korean_numbers = {
